research_scope: Cross-link every documented Parallel Quest skill reward to the canonical skills catalog without inventing missing skills or silently normalizing historical names.
method: scripts/validate_pq_skill_links.py scans every pq-batch-*.json record, reads skill_rewards, normalizes case/typographic apostrophes, resolves only explicitly documented aliases, and reports unresolved links.
canonical_policy: Exact canonical matches are preferred. Known spelling/transcription variants may be represented by an explicit alias. Unknown names fail validation and require research/correction rather than automatic invention.
special_cases: PQ36 and PQ141-PQ150 are handled as numbering/cut states by the separate numbering reconciliation and are not manufactured as quests.
Skill reward percentages remain separate from name-link validation and are not inferred by this validator.
